item.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: complete responsive task checklist app concept for implementation
Primary request: Create a polished, production-minded visual concept for a calm personal task checklist app called “Daymark”. Show the complete primary desktop app screen at a readable 1440x1000-like composition and include a clearly separated narrow mobile continuation/state within the same visual system so responsive behavior is understandable. The app must visibly support the core workflow: add a task, mark tasks complete, and delete tasks, with a persistent-feeling checklist and progress summary.
Purpose and audience: a focused personal workspace for someone planning a small set of meaningful tasks; the interface should feel thoughtful, fast, and reassuring rather than corporate.
Exact visible content: main heading “Good morning, Alex”, helper text “A small list for a clear mind.”, primary input placeholder “What needs doing?”, button label “Add task”, filter labels “All”, “Open”, “Done”, section labels “Today” and “Completed”, sample task text “Outline the launch note”, “Book a dentist appointment”, “Water the balcony herbs”, “Send the project recap”, “Read 20 pages”, and a small progress label “3 of 5 complete”. Keep visible UI copy code-native and legible.
Structure: quiet top bar with a simple Daymark wordmark and a small date; spacious main column with heading and add-task form; an open list with checkbox rows, subtle dividers, completion strike-through, and a delete affordance that appears on row hover; a compact progress summary with a simple ring or horizontal progress visual; a small right-side “Today” context area on desktop; mobile version collapses to one column with a sticky add form and the same list.
Interaction model: focused input, clear primary add button, checkbox selected states, delete icon button, filter tabs, hover/focus affordances, completed rows visibly distinct, no modal.
Visual system: one clear creative direction—editorial calm with warm paper white background (#fbfaf7), deep ink text (#202229), muted slate text, thin lilac-gray borders, accent lavender-blue (#6b63d8) with a restrained coral delete/attention accent; typography pairing of a characterful serif display heading with a clean sans-serif UI; low-to-medium density, generous whitespace, 16px-ish radii only for the main form/progress surfaces, mostly open list layout, tiny soft shadows, refined line icons, accessible contrast, polished micro-interactions implied. Keep the desktop layout balanced and the mobile continuation practical.
Implementation constraints: React + Vite friendly; use code-native HTML UI text and controls, semantic accessible controls, reusable components and tokens, local state and localStorage persistence, responsive layout; no hero-like marketing wrapper, no fake metrics, no unrelated sections, no default bento grid, no decorative badges or eyebrow/pill above the main heading, no rasterized app screenshot as the final UI.
